lines.zh: 我太小了，草都比我高，只能一蹦一蹦。
lines.en: I am so small the grass is taller; I can only hop.
I am so small that the grass is taller.

lines.zh: 我这团绒球，滚起来没方向。
lines.en: This puffball rolls with no direction.
I walk crowded together with the others.
The fallen leaf is bigger than my foot.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块比我还高的石子。
lines.en: I go around a pebble taller than I am.
I walk holding on to your trouser leg.
I stop every three steps.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到干燥的草上。
lines.en: I creep onto dry grass.

lines.zh: 我蹦起来，落下来，滚了一下。
lines.en: I hop, drop, and roll once.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，绒毛沾满土。
lines.en: I roll over, fluff covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴队伍的后面。
lines.en: I follow at the back of the group.
I flick the grass seeds with a paw.
I draw myself into a small ball.
I look slowly left and right.
My little claws grip the ground.
I lift my head at every sound.
I am waiting for feed.
My stats are only one or two.
The sun on the grass is warm.

lines.zh: 我这么小一团，滚起来就停不住。
lines.en: A lump this small, once rolling, cannot stop.
I give a tiny burp.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进自己的绒毛。
lines.en: I bury my face in my own fluff.
This meadow is enough for me to play in.
I prick my ears to the rustle of grass.
I press to the ground and keep still.
Are you the one who keeps me?
I have not evolved yet.
I can blow bubbles.
Could you crouch down?
I am so small. Do not step on me.
I am hungry. Is there feed?
I push my head toward your hand.
I will grow into something else.
I know your shoes.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的裤脚，等你迈步。
lines.en: I hold your cuff and wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都在这片草地。
lines.en: My friends are all in this meadow.

lines.zh: 我踮起脚，也只到你的膝。
lines.en: On tiptoe, I barely reach your knee.
Is there anything I can help with?

lines.zh: 我缩到你身后，只露半个头。
lines.en: I hide behind you, half a head showing.
A Baby I stage moves slowly.
When you smile, I want to smile too.
Ow, that one really hurts.

lines.zh: 呜，这一下好疼，我滚出去老远。
lines.en: Ow, that hurt; I rolled far.
I lie on the ground and keep still.
My stats have dropped.
I stand up, trembling.
I roll into the grass and keep trembling.
I hide behind your feet.
There is earth and blood on me.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛发着抖，站起来了。
lines.en: My fluff trembling, I get back up.
Dragging myself, I squeeze between grass blades.
Feed! I can smell it.
I cannot reach; I hop twice.
One hop and I am there.
My whole face is covered in feed.
So little — can I have more?
After eating, I lick the corners of my mouth.
I hold the feed in my mouth, loath to swallow.
After this I will have more strength.
I nuzzle your fingers.
Delicious. I will remember this.
I will save a little for my friends.

lines.zh: 再来一点，就一点，泡泡要没了。
lines.en: A little more, just a little; my bubbles are fading.
Oops, I got knocked rolling.
I get up, a little dizzy.
You stepped on the grass beside me.
I have moved off to one side.
We nearly collided.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The bump rolls me onto my back.
I am so small you probably felt nothing.
Barely out of the shell, and I bump into you.
I roll past your foot.
I roll upright and steady.
Let us go to that meadow together.
Walk slower and wait for me.
My friends follow you too.
We look for food together.
Crouch down and I will come closer.
I tug your trouser leg; do not shake me off.
Let us sleep huddled together.
I will call you when I am hungry.
Same meadow tomorrow.

lines.zh: 有你在，我就不怕大东西。
lines.en: With you here, big things do not scare me.
I hold it in both hands.
I cannot hold it; I carry it on my back.
I cannot carry it, so I push it.
I push it with my head, slowly.
It fell on my head.
I slowly push it up.

lines.zh: 我先舔了一下，又缩回手。
lines.en: I lick it once and pull my hand back.
I have hidden it in the grass.
Too heavy. I let go.
I hold it overhead to show you.
There is a big thing over there.
I hide in the grass.
I can blow bubbles.
My stats are too low.
I stand behind your foot.
Will it see me?
I only hop, and not far.
On three, I spring out.
Fighting is not my strength; blocking is.
Will you help me?
It is taller than the trees.
I flatten my small body into the grass.
I watch it through the gaps in the grass.
I creep one small step closer.

lines.zh: 我一点一点蹭到它脚后。
lines.en: I creep inch by inch behind its heel.
I count its steps.
I dare not lift my head.
The grass can hide me.

lines.zh: 我贴着草根，连气都不敢出。
lines.en: Pressed to the roots, I barely breathe.

lines.zh: 小小的我，从这边绕过去。
lines.en: Tiny as I am, I go round this way.
I press my belly to the earth.
Almost at its feet.
I fill my lungs and tense my legs.
Right — up I go.
I blow a bubble.
The bubble pops, quietly.
I bounce off it and fly far.
That had little effect.
Dizzy, I cannot tell which way is up.

lines.zh: 泡泡擦过它的脸就破了。
lines.en: The bubble grazes its face and pops.
I stand again and look at it.
My bubble struck its eye.
It drew back; I drew back too.
I bite its trouser leg and hold on.
I sit down, panting.

lines.zh: 我吸满气，又吐一个泡泡。
lines.en: I draw breath and blow another bubble.
I roll out of the eggshell.

lines.zh: 草地上多了一个小小的身影。
lines.en: There is one more tiny shape on the meadow.

lines.zh: 我现在的数值只有一点。
lines.en: My stats are only one point now.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我滚到草地上。
lines.en: The eggshell cracks; I tumble onto the grass.
I take two staggering steps.
The grass is very thick here.
I stand on the spot and look around.
My friends are nearby too.
I try blowing a bubble.

lines.zh: 我第一次闻到饲料的味道。
lines.en: This is the first time I have smelt feed.
I push out between grass blades.
I am small and easy to keep.
So hot — I roll away.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔得直晕。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land dizzy.
Water closes over me and I flail.
There was a boom and I was blown away.
I'm so small I have one or two health.
My program scrambled for a moment.

lines.zh: 我这么小一团，饿得发软。
lines.en: This tiny blob of mine goes soft with hunger.
The thunder makes me curl up.
I fall, tumbling over and over.
